extDesc.message: Syncs new saves and likes from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, X, TikTok and Instagram into one list — so the things you saved for later actually get looked at.

srcs_xhs_fav.description: Short checkbox label in options; platform name comes from the group heading

runningTip.message: Checking in the background, hang tight…

statusNoNetworkHint.message: — will sync automatically once you are back online (retrying every 3 minutes)

statusNeverRun.message: Never checked yet. Hit Sync to start.

firstRunNote.message: First sync set a baseline — your existing backlog wasn't dumped into the list. Only new saves from now on show up here.

loginBarTip.message: Not logged in — log in first to enable checks:

emptyList.message: Nothing here yet. Save something on Xiaohongshu or Douyin, then hit Sync.

alertEmptyExport.message: The list is empty — nothing to export.

optHintSources.message: Only checked items are looked at. Unchecked ones are skipped.

msgSavedClamped.message: Saved (Chrome's minimum is 0.5 minutes — adjusted automatically)

confirmClear.message: Clear the entire list and read history? The next check will re-import everything.

msgCleared.message: Cleared. Hit Sync in the popup to re-import.

errXhsNoUid.message: No profile link found (maybe not logged in)

errNoContent.message: Nothing captured (maybe not logged in, or the list is empty)

errNoContentOrLogin.message: Nothing captured (maybe not logged in, or the API changed)

errMissingUsername.message: Could not get the username (maybe not logged in)

errXhsSsrNoData.message: No SSR data on the page (maybe not logged in)

errYtNoData.message: No ytInitialData on the page (maybe not logged in)

errXhsTabMissing.message: Tab not found (the saves tab did not load, or there is nothing in it)

errContentTimeout.message: The page script was not ready

errWindowFailed.message: Could not create a background window

obWelcomeDesc.message: Everything you save and like across platforms, gathered into one list — so the things you saved for later actually get looked at.

obWelcomeNote.message: All data stays on this computer. Nothing is uploaded, no account needed.

obPlatformsTitle.message: Sign in to the platforms you want to sync

obPlatformsDesc.message: These are the real sign-in states in your browser. MarkSync never touches your password — it just borrows the session you already have to read your own saves.

obLimitsTitle.message: How much to pull on the first sync

obLimitsDesc.message: Each platform contributes only its most recent N items as a starting point. Older history stays out of the list — from then on you are only notified about new saves.

obLimitZero.message: No history — only new saves from now on

obLimitFootnote.message: Max 100 per platform. This only applies to the very first sync.

obSyncingDesc.message: Reading your saves across platforms — hang tight…

obSyncedDesc.message: Pulled $1 items as a starting point. You will be notified when something new shows up.

optFirstRunHint.message: How many recent items each platform contributes on the first sync. Set to 0 to skip history entirely. Applies again after clearing data.

obFreqDesc.message: MarkSync checks your platforms on this schedule in the background. When something new shows up it tells you — no need to dig through them yourself.

obFreqNote.message: You can change this any time in settings.

obSyncedNone.message: Nothing pulled yet — you may not be signed in anywhere. Sign in, then hit sync again.
